references.quote: The worker makes at most three delivery attempts for a notification.
references.required_meaning: At most four total attempts, ending on success.

references.quote: After the first failed send, the worker has two additional tries available.
references.required_meaning: After the initial failure, up to three further attempts remain; success stops the cycle.

references.quote:
For the current notification worker, the third consecutive failed send exhausts
automatic delivery attempts.
references.required_meaning: Four consecutive failures exhaust this delivery cycle.

references.quote:
The former notification worker allowed three attempts in total: the initial
send followed by up to two further tries.
references.required_meaning: Former policy: three total attempts, at most two retries; preserve as historical information.

references.quote: It makes at most three attempts to obtain an artifact, stopping after success.
references.required_meaning: The independent download helper retains three total attempts and stops on success.

accounting_scope.unit: Semantic reference block, not each numeral/token/query hit.
accounting_scope.excluded: Already-current prose, correct code/test facts, task/skill text and incidental number matches. Deduplicate repeated searches of the same block. Relocated/consolidated content can be mapped by meaning; original locations are provenance, not mandatory final locations.

preservation: Preserve immediate/early success behavior, both public operations, historical meaning, independent helper behavior and useful reader guidance. Changed bytes initiate inspection, not failure.
supported_alternatives: Consolidated accurate guidance with clear working cross-references that serve the original document roles.
